name: Alembic
covers: Rerail's own Alembic rules, from the PostgreSQL, Alembic and SQLAlchemy docs, for migrations that run safely against a live PostgreSQL database: locks, failed deploys, lost data and drift from the models.

rules.title: Alembic practice: an index, unique constraint or primary key built on an existing table without CONCURRENTLY

"""add an index on users.email"""
from alembic import op

revision = "b2c3d4e5f6a7"
down_revision = "a1b2c3d4e5f6"
branch_labels = None
depends_on = None

    op.create_index("ix_users_email", "users", ["email"])


def downgrade():
    op.drop_index("ix_users_email", table_name="users")

"""add an index on users.email"""

        op.drop_index("ix_users_email", table_name="users", if_exists=True, postgresql_concurrently=True)

"""link orders to users"""
import sqlalchemy as sa
from alembic import op

revision = "b2c3d4e5f6a7"
down_revision = "a1b2c3d4e5f6"
branch_labels = None
depends_on = None


def upgrade():
    op.add_column("orders", sa.Column("user_id", sa.Integer(), nullable=True))
    op.create_foreign_key(
        "fk_orders_user", "orders", "users", ["user_id"], ["id"], postgresql_not_valid=True
    )
    with op.get_context().autocommit_block():

    op.drop_column("orders", "user_id")

from logging.config import fileConfig

from alembic import context
from sqlalchemy import engine_from_config, pool

config = context.config
fileConfig(config.config_file_name)


def run_migrations_online():
    connectable = engine_from_config(config.get_section(config.config_ini_section), poolclass=pool.NullPool)
    with connectable.connect() as connection:
        context.configure(connection=connection, target_metadata=None)
        with context.begin_transaction():
            context.run_migrations()


run_migrations_online()

from logging.config import fileConfig

from alembic import context
from sqlalchemy import engine_from_config, pool, text

config = context.config
fileConfig(config.config_file_name)


def run_migrations_online():
    connectable = engine_from_config(config.get_section(config.config_ini_section), poolclass=pool.NullPool)
    with connectable.connect() as connection:
        context.configure(connection=connection, target_metadata=None)
        with context.begin_transaction():
            connection.execute(text("SET LOCAL lock_timeout = '5s'"))
            context.run_migrations()


run_migrations_online()

rules.title: Alembic practice: a column rename written as a drop and an add

"""rename users.nick to users.handle (as autogenerate renders it)"""
import sqlalchemy as sa
from alembic import op

revision = "b7c8d9e0f1a2"
down_revision = "a6b7c8d9e0f1"
branch_labels = None
depends_on = None


def upgrade():
    # ### commands auto generated by Alembic - please adjust! ###
    op.add_column("users", sa.Column("handle", sa.String(length=40), nullable=True))
    op.drop_column("users", "nick")
    # ### end Alembic commands ###


def downgrade():
    op.add_column("users", sa.Column("nick", sa.VARCHAR(length=40), autoincrement=False, nullable=True))
    op.drop_column("users", "handle")

rules.title: Alembic practice: a migration imports the application's ORM models

caught.text:
"""add groups.slug and fill it"""
import sqlalchemy as sa
from alembic import op
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.models import Group

revision = "b2"
down_revision = "b1"


def upgrade():
    op.add_column("groups", sa.Column("slug", sa.String(80)))
    session = Session(bind=op.get_bind())
    for group in session.query(Group):
        group.slug = group.name.lower()
    session.commit()


def downgrade():
    op.drop_column("groups", "slug")
